purpose: Forward propagation of the small subset of Level 0 parameters having defensible independent numeric bounds; not calibration
sample_design: deterministic Latin hypercube with independent uniform screening coordinates

k1_DKE.basis: union of Schmitz 2000 low-iodide 1200 +/- 150 and the DKE historical value

k8_DKE.basis: DKE historical value to the Bielski et al. evaluated value

k10_DKE.basis: union of Shin et al. 29 +/- 5.2 and the DKE historical value; condition-transfer screen only

excluded_parameters.k2_DKE: analogy estimate with no iodine-specific interval
excluded_parameters.k4_DKE: global fit with no direct interval
excluded_parameters.k_minus4_DKE: analogy estimate with no iodine-specific interval
excluded_parameters.k5_DKE: modern subsystem values conflict by orders of magnitude and are a model-form alternative
excluded_parameters.k6_DKE: global fit and unresolved manganese coordination
